name: Virtualization Solution
summary: Adversaries may carry out malicious operations using virtualization solutions to escape from Android sandboxes and to avoid detection. Android uses sandboxes to separate resources and code execution between applications and the operating system. There are a few virtualization solutions available on Android, such as the Android Virtualization Framework (AVF).
